svg.title: A multimode nonlinear Schrödinger equation for optical propagation. Its terms represent attenuation, chromatic dispersion, linear mode coupling and the Kerr nonlinearity.
svg.desc: LaTeX source \frac{\partial\bm E}{\partial z}=\left[-\frac{\alpha}{2}\mathbf I-i\frac{\beta_2}{2}\frac{\partial^2}{\partial t^2}\mathbf I+i\mathbf K+i\frac{8\gamma}{9}\left(\sum_{m=1}^{M}|E_m|^2\right)\mathbf I\right]\bm E
